ENGINEER BY CRAFT. BUILDER BY NATURE.

I like the point where an ambiguous problem becomes a clear technical direction—and then a working product.

At Ada, I’ve grown from intern to senior engineer, building AI agent capabilities and leading projects from early architecture through delivery. I start hands-on, prove the approach, and bring others in as the work grows.

Before and alongside that, I co-founded Kabby and City OS. Building my own products taught me to think beyond the implementation: who needs this, what matters first, and what does it take to ship?

My interest in building started with robotics. Today, that same curiosity shows up in AI systems, full-stack products, and the tools that help teams move faster.
